fixture.source: Original native installation and enrollment; canonical Planner/domain, source and Decisions commands.

realCommands.readback: Changed objective and increased version; exact submitted id/incarnation/version, idempotency key present, unchanged sourceRefs and criteria.
Original case version and questions unchanged; prepared proposal remains distinct from recording/sending.

newCaseScopeRegression.scope: Canonical Planner source/case and original global selection with fresh leases after controlled expiry; common fences and explicitly structural eligible Procurement negatives.

preview.origin: Original bounded SF_DESIGN_PREVIEW chunks from the official successful job log.
preview.canonicalPngLocation: Original Playwright attachments in the run artifact.

integrationReview.note: Independent final review found no visual blockers; original unavailable, empty and conditional states remain clear.

areas.name: Case summary
areas.behavior: Retained edit/review/cancel/reopen, one decision-edit POST, exact case CAS and unchanged source references/criteria on original readback.
areas.limit: Source attachments are disclosed; no new evidence is invented.

areas.name: Alternatives
areas.behavior: Authorized empty alternative/choice state, actual two-source amounts and comparison, historical choice on the opaque case route.
areas.limit: The original producer does not admit current-choice preparation in this installation; no provenance, recalculation or promotion is fabricated.

areas.name: Assumptions
areas.behavior: Open assumptions, confirmed filter with genuine filtered-empty state, exact evidence detail, empty derived missing categories and original coverage divergences.
areas.limit: Review does not confirm or mutate an assumption.

areas.name: Questions
areas.behavior: Retained composer and review, one actual sf_question_prepare POST, unchanged case version/question list.
areas.limit: Preparation does not send or record a question. Optional cycle/recipient reads remain unavailable when unadmitted.

areas.name: Current choice
areas.behavior: Actual recorded choice and explicit producer preparation refusal.
areas.limit: No source provenance or successful recalculation is fabricated.

areas.name: Prepared changes
areas.limit: Populated application/CAS/recovery paths are preserved but are not browser-qualified by this fixture.

areas.name: Application result
areas.limit: No apply/recover request or receipt is invented; populated receipt detail remains unqualified.

areas.name: Analysis
areas.behavior: Original choices/list POST reads, real selector counts and history, objective input and actual catalog admission state.
areas.limit: No provider credential, model, run or output is fabricated. Prepare/start/cancel/output require separately admitted source configuration.

limits: UI35/UI38 show the actual recorded choice, but the original producer does not admit current-choice preparation. No missing-provenance cause is inferred beyond its returned refusal; recalculation and promotion are not browser-qualified.
UI36 reviews and filters assumptions; it does not confirm or mutate them. Producer codes and authored evidence remain literal.
UI37 prepares one proposal but does not record or send it. The optional cycle/recipient reads remain unavailable when not admitted; their populated states are not qualified.

UI39/UI40 have genuine empty prepared-change and application-receipt ledgers. Populated application, CAS conflict, recovery and receipt-detail states are preserved but not exercised by this browser fixture.

UI41 has original authorized cases, analysis options and an empty history, but no admitted model. Preparation review, start, cancel and output are not exercised; no provider credentials, model, run or result are fabricated.

The case-scope regression uses original authority, SQLite, sources and Planner producers with a bounded test identity provider. Its eligible Procurement negatives use an explicitly structural planned-change fixture; they do not prove an emitted C12 preparation, application or receipt.

Visual evidence is Chromium at 1440x1100, 390x844 and 320x800. It covers the recorded theme/locale states, not the full theme/locale/viewport cross-product, browser zoom, every browser or every preserved business state.
Producer-supplied Portuguese reasons and raw state/code values remain literal in an English UI. Existing EN/pt-BR UI catalogs were not rewritten.
